answer: The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. The inspector keeps the 125 POA fee whether the proof passes or not, so 423 proofs drain 52875 POA from the farm and give nothing back. Where a farm sees a gap, Puppetmaker toy horse warrant counted beside the doll loft sees a record, and the record says each toy horse is a year of varnish logs in the ledger. A canyon can be painted, a saffron can be borrowed, but a whisper must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing.
